title: Grateful Dead Live at Merramec Community College on 1970-05-14

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of a fast‑paced 1970 show featuring a standout Friend Of The Devil, though the split‑track handling of New Speedway Boogie irks some listeners.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its energetic early‑70s tempo, especially the quick‑moving Friend Of The Devil and the lively New Speedway Boogie. The soundboard source delivers clear, balanced audio, but a few fans are frustrated by the decision to split New Speedway Boogie into three separate tracks.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings and enthusiastic comments about both the music and the soundboard quality, with only minor complaints about track splitting.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and balanced soundboard capture; no audio fidelity issues reported. The only technical gripe is the unnecessary division of New Speedway Boogie into three tracks, which disrupts continuity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show maintains the brisk, upbeat feel of early‑1970 performances, with fast‑paced numbers like Friend Of The Devil and an energetic New Speedway Boogie keeping the momentum high.
